acceptance: make pr-open, including the trunk-revert gate and the PR lookup, create, edit, and number resolution, makes no GraphQL call
Every existing pre-publication check and refusal is unchanged
An existing open PR for the branch is reused and its body updated when PR_BODY_FILE is given
Tests cover the REST lookup, create, reuse, and cross-repository head cases
context: Split from pr-workflow-cloud-env-compat, which also asks pr-arm to merge directly on a 422 clean-status response; that part is not adopted, because builders never arm and a direct merge would bypass auto-merge's required-check wait.
description: Claude Code cloud sessions block GitHub GraphQL (HTTP 403: GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions; use the REST API). make pr-open uses gh pr list, gh pr create, gh pr edit, and gh pr view, which use GraphQL, so a cloud builder cannot open its own PR. Move pr-open and the checks it calls onto REST (gh api) routes so the same target works locally and in cloud sessions, keeping every pre-publication check: write preflight, branch guard, conflict refusal, trunk-revert gate, conflict scan, push before open, existing-PR reuse.
